title: Version canonical measurement and settlement definitions
integration: domain.py, schema exports, and matching comparison only where the versioned contract requires it.
contract: Publish a versioned Pydantic definition contract for adjustment, precision, revision policy, observation bounds and timezone; retain unknown values explicitly.
acceptance: Monthly/annual, adjusted/unadjusted, strict/inclusive and initial/revised differences remain distinguishable.
Document migration and invalidation for existing definitions and reviews.
No missing field can increase approval confidence.
tests: Backward compatibility and conflicting-field tests; regenerate affected JSON schemas.
excluded: No venue parsers, LLM integration, frontend, or broad repository refactor.

title: Persist immutable settlement source artifacts
integration: One new Alembic revision; model registration in storage/models.py if needed.
contract: Source artifact includes venue, URL, retrieval time, content digest, content/type and market association; retrieval failures are explicit.
acceptance: Repeated identical captures are idempotent.
Source changes preserve previous artifacts for audit.
Bound document sizes and record retrieval failures without marking evidence complete.
tests: PostgreSQL persistence, source versioning and migration checks.
excluded: No exchange fetchers, parser behavior, browser or arbitrary URL crawler.

title: Enrich Kalshi contracts with series and resolution-source evidence
integration: Kalshi adapter hook and source repository calls only; coordinate terms-hash changes with C01.
contract: Enrichment returns source artifacts and referenced settlement evidence for a market; use official documentation and recorded responses.
acceptance: Capture series source and contract references for recorded CPI markets.
Terms changes invalidate affected evidence/reviews.
Missing source or failed retrieval remains visible and never invents jurisdiction.
tests: Recorded HTTP fixtures, retries/cache behavior and changed-source invalidation.
excluded: No Polymarket changes, fee calculation or negative-risk support.

title: Capture Polymarket resolution-source and supplemental rule evidence
integration: Polymarket adapter hook and source repository calls only.
contract: Preserve resolution-source references and documented supplemental terms with versioned provenance; verify current official API support.
acceptance: Original descriptions and supported supplemental terms remain auditable.
Unavailable external evidence is labeled incomplete.
External fetches use bounded allowlisted sources, timeouts and size limits.
tests: Recorded responses including missing evidence, changes and malformed documents.
excluded: No Kalshi code, general web scraping, fee calculation or changes to negative-risk eligibility.

title: Discover overlapping supported event families
integration: Adapter filter parameters, config and a worker catalog hook only where needed.
contract: Produce a bounded catalog with inclusion/exclusion reasons, independent of hot order-book polling; explicit watchlists retain precedence.
acceptance: Search configured event families on both venues rather than arbitrary first results.
Report unsupported outcomes, missing source evidence and scan limits.
Catalog scheduling does not block quote ingestion.
tests: Recorded pagination, duplicate markets, unrelated categories, watchlist precedence and exhausted scans.
excluded: No semantics approval, WebSockets or frontend.

title: Add labeled supported cross-exchange contract pairs
integration: Corpus loader extension only if required for additive fixture directories.
contract: Independent labels and source provenance for supported positive candidates and hard negatives; no fabricated equivalence.
acceptance: Include jurisdiction, source, measurement, period and exception differences.
Demonstrate at least one supported same-event pair, or document evidence that the chosen family lacks one and keep the milestone open.
Human settlement review is distinct from extraction gold labels.
tests: Offline adapter-to-comparison replay, payload digests, false-match assertions and per-family coverage.
excluded: No silent expansion of supported instruments or extractor-authored gold labels.

title: Extract Kalshi definitions from enriched real rules
integration: One explicit extraction dispatcher hook; preserve existing extraction API.
contract: Convert enriched evidence into partial ContractDefinition proposals with exact citations and parser version.
acceptance: Extract only facts supported by source artifacts.
Increase measured recorded coverage without incorrect fields.
Conflicts and missing exception terms remain unverified.
tests: Recorded positive and negative grammar cases, reporting-vs-release dates, evidence version changes.
excluded: No approval automation, fee rules, LLM, or Polymarket parser.

title: Extract Polymarket definitions from enriched real rules
integration: One extraction dispatcher hook; coordinate that small shared edit with M01.
contract: Produce evidence-backed partial definitions, distinguish event-wide descriptions from outcome-specific conditions.
acceptance: Keep core/headline, CPI/PCE, annual/monthly and country differences explicit.
Do not apply one outcome threshold to sibling markets.
No eligibility or negative-risk rule is relaxed by extraction.
tests: Recorded shared descriptions, outcome labels, exclusions and conflicting supplemental terms.
excluded: No automatic approvals, Kalshi parser or live LLM integration.

title: Evaluate structured LLM extraction offline
integration: Optional isolated dependency/config only with documented need; no worker hook in this PR.
contract: An offline evaluator validates structured model proposals against the same definitions and source evidence; default tests do not call paid APIs.
acceptance: Compare coverage, incorrect facts, abstention and reproducibility with deterministic baseline.
Reject unsupported citations, schema errors and source-text instructions.
Document model/prompt version and a go/no-go decision; model output never grants approval.
tests: Mocked responses, prompt-injection fixtures and labeled evaluation report.
excluded: No production model calls, credentials in fixtures, or autonomous approval.

title: Validate exceptional settlement scenarios and review completeness
integration: Review validator and evaluate() hook only; regenerate schema if payoff representation changes.
contract: Validate supported payout mappings across ordinary, cancellation, fallback and ambiguous outcomes; explicitly reject unmodeled behavior.
acceptance: Reviewed exception policies map to named testable scenarios.
Noncomplementary or unsupported refunds fail closed.
Known counterexamples with both purchased legs losing are rejected.
tests: Truth tables and regression tests from recorded rules, including divergent resolution.
excluded: No generalized portfolio optimizer, automatic trading or invented proof of scenario completeness.

title: Define a versioned fee quote interface
integration: No engine integration; keep existing reviewed CostPolicy working.
contract: Decimal fee quote takes venue, market, side, quantity and fill prices and returns a conservative charge with source/version/expiry.
acceptance: Represent fixed, quantity- and price-dependent charges and rounding.
Unsupported or stale fee information returns an explicit unavailable result.
No default zero fee on errors.
tests: Contract validation, decimal serialization and unsupported policy cases.
excluded: No exchange-specific formulas or API calls.

title: Implement Kalshi fee metadata and calculations
integration: Reuse source enrichment if available; do not edit Polymarket or engine.
contract: Implement F01 against current official Kalshi fee rules with versioned evidence and market-specific overrides.
acceptance: Honor relevant series/market fee rules.
Round conservatively at the documented charge boundary.
Unsupported schedules produce unavailable results.
tests: Official worked examples, boundary prices, size changes, stale sources and overrides.
excluded: No order placement or hard-coded universal fee assumption.

title: Implement Polymarket fee metadata and calculations
integration: Use exchange HTTP/source helpers; do not edit Kalshi or engine.
contract: Implement F01 using current official market-specific Polymarket fee inputs and versioned evidence.
acceptance: Distinguish supported fee-enabled and fee-free cases using authoritative data.
Handle documented price dependence and rounding.
Unknown schedules cannot silently become fee-free.
tests: Official examples, quantity/price boundaries and missing or stale metadata.
excluded: No negative-risk trading, execution or shared engine refactor.

title: Integrate automatic fee quotes into opportunity sizing
integration: Pipeline fee-provider wiring, opportunity audit fields and generated schemas as necessary.
contract: Evaluation uses fresh supported fee quotes and retains reviewed conservative fallback only when explicitly configured and evidenced.
acceptance: Recalculate fees at each tested size and actual price ladder.
Persist the fee policy/version used in every opportunity.
Unavailable costs suppress the opportunity with a clear reason.
tests: Depth transitions, minimums, capital constraints, fee expiry and fallback provenance.
excluded: No review persistence changes, exchange transport or frontend.

title: Model depth impact and configurable execution slippage conservatively
integration: Sizing engine and settings hooks plus opportunity audit fields and schemas as necessary; merge after F04 to avoid competing engine edits.
contract: Walk executable ask depth for price impact, then apply an explicit configurable adverse-price allowance for quote-to-fill movement; combine with market-specific fees and capital requirements using Decimal.
acceptance: Net profit subtracts actual depth cost, market-specific fees, and the execution-slippage allowance before any opportunity is eligible.
Do not double-count spread or depth impact as an additional fee; distinguish estimated outlay from funds reserved at limit prices.
Recompute size-dependent fees at conservative prices when applicable and reject sizes whose worst supported outlay removes the edge.
Expose fee, depth cost, slippage allowance, limit-price assumptions and residual non-atomic fill risk separately; a reserve is not a guarantee.
tests: Regression examples where headline prices imply profit but fees, deeper levels, rounding or adverse price movement individually and jointly eliminate it; quantity, capital and strict minimum-profit boundaries.
excluded: No order placement, guaranteed-fill claims, market-impact model presented as certainty, UI or transport changes.

title: Persist versioned definition drafts and human reviews
integration: One new migration and model registration; coordinate migration head with D01.
contract: Immutable review revisions, mutable draft revisions and compare-and-swap updates bind terms, definitions, actor and timestamps.
acceptance: Concurrent edits cannot overwrite silently.
Historical approvals and rejections remain auditable.
A changed source or draft invalidates prior approval.
tests: PostgreSQL transactions, conflict detection, migration and audit reconstruction.
excluded: No authentication provider, HTTP mutation endpoints, UI or worker switch.

title: Add authentication and reviewer authorization
integration: Settings and narrow API dependency registration only.
contract: Expose a verified principal and role checks usable by review routes; select and document a standard identity integration, not custom password crypto.
acceptance: Reject missing, expired and invalid credentials for protected mutations.
Separate viewer/reviewer roles and derive audit identity server-side.
Document local development setup, CORS and session/CSRF requirements.
tests: Unauthorized, forbidden, expired credentials and cross-origin mutation tests.
excluded: No review storage, trading permissions or frontend screens.

title: Expose authenticated review and draft APIs
integration: Router registration in api/app.py and OpenAPI regeneration only.
contract: List drafts/reviews and create new revisions using expected revision IDs; return conflicts and field-level validation failures.
acceptance: Actor identity comes from authentication.
Approval requires current terms, complete evidence and scenario validation available at merge.
Concurrent/stale submissions return an actionable conflict without data loss.
tests: HTTP authorization, validation, concurrency and audit-history integration tests.
excluded: No browser, automatic approval or worker selection policy.

title: Use database approvals in the ingestion and evaluation pipeline
integration: Pipeline review loading and worker configuration only; retain documented file import compatibility.
contract: Load one coherent set of current approved revisions per cycle; define explicit precedence and migration from review files.
acceptance: Revocation and changed terms stop opportunities promptly.
Store the exact review revision used for audit.
Database/provider failures fail closed and expose health status.
tests: Ingestion-to-API approval/rejection/revocation tests, stale source and provider failure.
excluded: No review UI, transport changes or fee algorithm edits.

title: Add market and match search and filtering
integration: Move only affected read routes from app.py, preserve current response contracts, add indexes via one migration if justified.
contract: Bounded stable pagination and filters for venue, status, family, text, match status and evidence completeness.
acceptance: Filters are applied before pagination.
Queries remain mode-isolated and parameterized.
Existing clients retain documented defaults.
tests: Combined filters, empty results, stable ordering, SQLite/PostgreSQL and query-plan checks for added indexes.
excluded: No review mutations, arbitrary SQL search or broad repository reorganization.

title: Scaffold the Next.js application and shared UI foundation
integration: Root ignore rules and a local startup documentation section only; this issue initially owns web bootstrap/config files.
contract: Create the agreed Next.js/TypeScript/Tailwind/shadcn foundation, navigation, providers and test configuration with pinned dependencies.
acceptance: App builds and runs against configurable backend URL.
Accessible navigation and shared error/loading primitives exist.
No fake opportunity is presented as live data.
tests: Typecheck, production build and initial Vitest component checks.
excluded: No feature screens, backend changes, auth backend or fee logic.

title: Generate the typed API client and shared data access layer
integration: Web package scripts/lockfile and CI generation command only with W01 owner coordination.
contract: Generate types from docs/openapi.json; centralize base URL, errors, cancellation and TanStack Query keys; retain Decimal strings.
acceptance: Generation is reproducible and drift-detectable.
Simulation mode and API errors are represented explicitly.
No binary floating-point conversion for financial values.
tests: Mocked API responses, exact decimal strings, cancellation and generated-client drift.
excluded: No feature pages or backend schema redesign.

title: Build the market browser and source detail screen
integration: Navigation entry and shared API types only if required; no shared layout redesign.
contract: Browse and filter markets, inspect original terms, source versions and quote health using existing endpoints.
acceptance: Pagination and URL filters are usable.
Show simulation/live labels and stale/missing data clearly.
Accessible empty, loading and failure states are included.
tests: Component tests and focused Playwright flow with visual inspection at desktop and mobile widths.
excluded: No draft editing, approvals or opportunity calculations in JavaScript.

title: Build the read-only contract comparison screen
integration: Navigation entry and generated API refresh only if required.
contract: Render proposed pairs, side-by-side source terms, exact quotations, field differences and unresolved assumptions.
acceptance: Shared event is never labeled verified solely by similarity.
Unknown/conflicting terms and stale approval are prominent.
Source text is safely rendered and evidence is inspectable.
tests: Component and focused browser tests for candidate, conflict, incomplete and verified states; visual QA.
excluded: No mutation APIs, auth implementation or review form.

title: Build authenticated draft editing and review actions
integration: Client session adapter and navigation only; reuse backend authorization contract.
contract: Edit versioned drafts and approve/reject pairs using authenticated APIs and explicit revision preconditions.
acceptance: Expired sessions and forbidden actions are handled.
Conflicting edits preserve user input and require refresh/reconciliation.
Approval shows source evidence, costs, scenarios and consequences before submission.
tests: Browser tests for edit/approve/reject, stale terms, concurrent edits and session expiry; visual QA.
excluded: No browser-only security enforcement, trading controls or backend rule changes.

title: Build the opportunity dashboard with live status
integration: One reusable SSE client under the feature; route/nav wiring only.
contract: Render backend-calculated prices, quantities, costs, payout scenarios, expiry and audit links; reconnect SSE without stale success state.
acceptance: Clearly identify quote-supported estimates and simulation.
Show partial-fill assumptions and stale/disconnected/empty states.
Financial formatting preserves exact supplied decimals.
Show fees, depth cost and slippage allowance separately and show net profit after all costs.
tests: Component tests and browser reconnect/expiry scenarios with visual inspection.
excluded: No frontend arbitrage math, orders, balances or execution UI.

title: Define order-book stream and resynchronization contracts
integration: No live worker integration; preserve current Book consumers.
contract: Exchange-neutral snapshot/delta events, sequence state, receipt/source timestamps, bounded buffers and resync requirements.
acceptance: Gap, duplicate and out-of-order behavior is explicit.
Disconnected/unsynchronized books cannot be eligible.
Snapshots reconstruct the existing normalized Book model exactly.
tests: Deterministic state-machine tests for gaps, duplication, overflow and snapshot replacement.
excluded: No venue sockets or worker scheduling changes.

title: Implement Kalshi order-book streaming
integration: Reuse Kalshi auth helpers; move only signing code if needed, with adapter regression tests.
contract: Implement L01 from documented Kalshi messages with authentication, subscriptions and reconnect/resync.
acceptance: Validate sequence/order-book integrity before publishing.
Refresh required auth and restore subscriptions after disconnect.
Bound reconnect backoff and buffers.
tests: Recorded snapshot/delta transcripts, sequence gaps, invalid messages and reconnect tests.
excluded: No Polymarket stream, worker rollout or order placement.

title: Implement Polymarket order-book streaming
integration: Reuse token mapping and HTTP snapshot helpers only as necessary.
contract: Implement L01 from documented Polymarket channels; do not invent sequence guarantees where the protocol has none.
acceptance: YES/NO token mapping and timestamps remain correct.
Resubscribe and reconcile with full snapshots on uncertainty.
Maintain current unsupported-instrument exclusions.
tests: Recorded messages, token mismatches, reconnects and authoritative snapshot reconciliation.
excluded: No Kalshi stream, negative-risk support or worker rollout.

title: Integrate streams with worker lifecycle and health
integration: Worker/main.py, pipeline.py, settings and health hooks only; coordinate shared integration edits with R04/F04.
contract: Run catalog refresh and hot book updates independently with REST fallback and graceful shutdown.
acceptance: Feed interruption invalidates affected opportunities promptly.
Resync is required before renewed eligibility.
Backpressure and cancellation do not leak tasks or block catalog refresh.
tests: Worker-level disconnect/gap/recovery, REST fallback and shutdown integration tests.
excluded: No UI, fee algorithms or review policy changes.

title: Revalidate opportunity quotes before actionable presentation
integration: One read-only revalidation route, schema export and opportunity provenance fields as needed.
contract: Recheck both legs, fees and approval revision against fresh snapshots; return refreshed evidence or explicit invalidation.
acceptance: Changed prices, size, source terms, fees or review status can invalidate the estimate.
Audit exact snapshots used for revalidation.
Never describe cross-exchange fills as atomic or guaranteed.
tests: Race, stale snapshot, disappearing depth and revoked review tests.
excluded: No trades, fund transfers, balance integrations or execution guarantees.

title: Verify the first hosted backend CI run
integration: Only minimal environment/dependency corrections needed for a green run; preserve test coverage.
contract: Publish current backend foundation commits and run existing workflow on GitHub, linking an actual hosted result.
acceptance: Lint, both databases, migration checks, recorded report and schema drift checks run.
Failures are fixed without removing assertions or masking errors.
Document branch-check setup for a maintainer without changing protections unilaterally.
tests: Hosted workflow URL and job output; rerun locally only when fixes require it.
excluded: No frontend CI, infrastructure deployment or broad dependency upgrades.

title: Add frontend CI and the full review-to-opportunity browser test
integration: Web test scripts and dedicated deterministic API seed harness only.
contract: Run generated-client checks, Vitest, production build and Playwright against a seeded backend; test discovery/comparison/review/opportunity flow.
acceptance: No external exchange credentials or live prices required.
Exercise rejection, revocation, stale feeds and simulation labels.
Record accessible desktop/mobile visual inspection and retain failure artifacts.
tests: Full browser workflow against PostgreSQL plus frontend CI run.
excluded: No production seed data, backend semantics changes or visual redesign.

title: Expose worker health and ingestion metrics
integration: Worker instrumentation hooks and metrics serving configuration only.
contract: Measure catalog duration, quote age, reconnects, retries, resyncs, evaluation blocks and worker heartbeat without unbounded labels.
acceptance: Metrics distinguish simulation/live and venue.
No secrets or raw rules in metric labels.
Metric endpoint and stopped-worker behavior are documented.
tests: Deterministic counter/gauge tests and endpoint integration checks.
excluded: No dashboard deployment or general tracing rollout.

title: Add dashboards and alert rules for feed and worker failures
integration: Optional local compose profile only; application code changes require separate justification.
contract: Provision dashboards and alerts from O01 and existing API metrics; document severity and response steps.
acceptance: Alerts cover stale worker, quote gaps, reconnect loops and repeated evaluation failures.
Include duration thresholds to avoid transient noise.
Validate rules against recorded metric scenarios.
tests: Prometheus rule validation and dashboard import/render checks.
excluded: No production provider provisioning or application instrumentation.

title: Add tracing across ingestion evaluation and API requests
integration: Narrow startup and span hooks in worker/pipeline/API, pinned dependencies and config only.
contract: Opt-in OpenTelemetry spans correlate catalog, book ingestion, matching and evaluation; exporter failures do not break discovery.
acceptance: Redact secrets and avoid full source payloads.
Sampling and disabled mode are documented.
Propagate useful correlation without unbounded attributes.
tests: In-memory exporter tests and disabled/failing exporter checks.
excluded: No metrics redesign, vendor-specific deployment or frontend changes.

title: Add a reproducible staging deployment and secret configuration
integration: Container health/startup configuration only when necessary; provider choice must be documented before provisioning.
contract: Deploy API, web, one worker and managed PostgreSQL with migrations, TLS, least-privilege secrets and rollback procedures.
acceptance: Simulation staging passes the end-to-end smoke workflow.
Worker exclusivity, health probes and migration ordering are verified.
Production credentials are never committed; spending/provisioning requires owner authorization.
tests: Staging deployment smoke, rollback rehearsal and documented configuration validation.
excluded: No automatic trading or production capital; this issue does not authorize purchasing infrastructure.

title: Document and rehearse database backup and recovery
integration: Deployment backup configuration only; do not modify application data retention opportunistically.
contract: Define recovery objectives and rehearse restore into an isolated environment with audit-history checks.
acceptance: Backup encryption/access and retention are documented.
Restore preserves source versions, snapshots and review/evaluation audit links.
Document measured recovery time and safe failover steps.
tests: Isolated restore drill and post-restore integrity/smoke checks.
excluded: No destructive tests against production or unrelated schema changes.

title: Assess negative-risk market support without enabling it
integration: None; adapter support flags remain unchanged.
contract: Use current official mechanics and recorded examples to determine whether the unit binary model can represent these contracts safely.
acceptance: Document conversion, collateral, payout and exceptional-settlement differences.
Provide concrete counterexamples and required model changes.
Recommend support or continued exclusion; any implementation needs a separate reviewed issue.
tests: Offline evidence and payoff examples checked against sources.
excluded: No relaxing supported() checks, trading or new execution scope.

title: Specify venue access and balance checks if execution is authorized
integration: None. Deferred and not ready for implementation without explicit product authorization.
contract: Document the boundary between discovery and future read-only account readiness checks; identify permissions and outstanding owner decisions.
acceptance: Current discovery remains credential-minimal.
No private account integration is enabled by this issue.
A future implementation issue must separately authorize its exact account scope.
tests: Document review only; no calls to private account endpoints.
excluded: No orders, custody, transfers, credential collection or account API implementation.
